name: commute
description: A commute shape rather than a step: pull away, surface streets, a freeway cruise, two lift-off regen events (current goes POSITIVE — the house sign rule), a stop at lights, then home and parked. The A/C is on the whole way, so the climate load is in the current too. Driven by speed, accelerator and brake; the model produces the current. Written for looking at the power and speed charts. Runs at REAL TIME (1x), like every shipped scenario bar degradation_arc: compress it yourself with --speed, or with the cockpit's Time card, so the clock is always one you chose (docs/SIMULATOR.md, 'Compressing time'). The drive is about a quarter of an hour at 1x.
